title: koeleria ciliata var. pyramidata
intro: Koeleria ciliata var. pyramidata, commonly known as pyramid grass, is a type of grass species within the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antioxidant properties. However, the specific bioactive constituents of Koeleria ciliata var. pyramidata are not well-documented, but it is believed to contain compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
